newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South African guard shoots bogus enumerator.
newsitem.headline: South African guard shoots bogus enumerator.

text.p: A burglar tried to bluff his way into a house by posing as an enumerator in South Africa's census but was shot and wounded by a security guard, census officials said on Friday.
They said a woman living in the house in Johannesburg called the guard on Thursday night when she realised the impostor did not have official identification.
The Central Statistics Service, which is running the census, has warned South Africans to be vigilant of criminals trying to take advantage of the operation to get into people's homes.
